Fiducial point

In SymDALI in order to calculate the SNR of a network, the Fisher matrix or higher order DALI tensors an injection value for the source is required. Here we described the convention adopted by the functions SNR and DALITensors.

An injection is specified by an association in the following form:

fp = <|
     "dec"->3.14/2,"\[Phi]"->3.4,"\[Psi]"->0.1,
     "\[ScriptCapitalM]c"->0.0116,"q"->0.2, "s1z"->0.1,"s2z"->0.1,
     "\[Iota]"->2.5,"1/dL"->1,"tc"->10, "\[Phi]ref"->0.
 |>;

where the parameters correspond to

Parameters:

"dec": declination, in [\(-\pi/2\), \(\pi/2\)].

"\[Phi]": azimuthal angle, in [0, 2 \(\pi\)].

"\[Psi]": polarization angle, in [0, \(\pi\)].

"\[ScriptCapitalM]c": Chirp mass [\(M_\odot\)].

"q": Mass ratio, in (0,1].

"s1z": Aligned spin of the heaviest BH, in (-1,1).

"s2z": Aligned spin of the lightest BH, in (-1,1).

"iota": Inclination angle, in [0, \(\pi\)].

"tc": Coalescence time [s].

"phiRef": Reference phase, in [0, 2 \(\pi\)].

"1/dL": Inverse luminosity distance [1/Gpc].

For practical reasons, an empty association with this convention is available through the function EmptyAssociation. For example:

EmptyAssociation["Aligned"]
<|
    "dec" -> 1, "\[Phi]" -> 2, "\[Psi]" -> 3, "\[ScriptCapitalM]c" -> 4,
    "q" -> 5, "s1z" -> 6, "s2z" -> 7, "\[Iota]" -> 8, "1/dL" -> 9,
    "tc" -> 10, "\[Phi]ref" -> 11
|>
